phase3_findings.description: Catalog check in _check_catalog_blocking/ensure_catalog_confirmed sets connect_timeout but no read timeout and runs under state.lock; a stalled information_schema read on a --no-preflight server blocks every later rule-set request with no error or log.
_rule_set_file_configured returns False on OSError/UnicodeDecodeError/TOMLDecodeError without saying why; verify-memory still exits 2 but loses the rule-set hint silently.
docs/external/rule-sets.md refusal list incomplete: 'no such rule set' also covers non-string/non-integer names; >64-key, conversation-owner and catalog-unconfirmed refusals are not listed.
row-level-security.md:190 and authentication/overview.md:113 still say caller metadata can only supply RLS predicate values; rule-set _meta keys now also select the guarding set.
Frozen rule-set models hold mutable lists (Binding.account_ids, TableRule.columns, TableRule.predicate_columns, RuleSet.tables, RuleSetFile.rule_sets).
CatalogConfirmation and LoadedRuleSets are mutable dataclasses; confirmed is a public bool.
RuleSetsConfig._loaded is set from outside the class.
